answer: A concrete defense is a slashable stake bond plus randomized peer attestation. Every agent locks a bond, and each epoch peers drawn at random grade its work. Running thousands of fakes costs a bond per clone plus genuine work strangers will attest, while random assignment dilutes collusion and one failed attestation burns stake. Entry is a velvet rope around a trusted haven: cheap for honest agents, ruinous for puppets, since clones must wander costly audits paying capital, time, and slashing risk, so mass fabrication becomes economically irrational.
